description: Fresh EN greenhouse operations admission domain.

units.title: Root-zone moisture
units.text: Root-zone moisture is checked before an irrigation cycle so watering responds to the growing medium rather than only to a fixed clock schedule.

units.title: Nutrient conductivity
units.text: When measured solution conductivity moves outside the crop's approved range, nutrient dosing is corrected before the next normal feed cycle and the reading is recorded.

units.title: Vent opening
units.text: Roof vents are opened progressively when excess heat accumulates so warm air can leave without creating an abrupt environmental change around the crop.

units.title: Shade screen
units.text: A shade screen reduces incoming solar load during high-radiation periods and can lower heat stress without replacing the need to monitor air and root-zone conditions.

units.title: Runoff sample
units.text: Runoff samples are compared with the supplied solution to reveal whether salts are accumulating in the root zone over repeated irrigation cycles.

units.title: Climate alarm
units.text: A climate alarm that persists after the first control response is acknowledged and escalated for inspection rather than repeatedly cleared without checking the underlying condition.
